dial.note: qubit i is flipped iff u_i < p (checked against sampleNoise with the same seed)

curves.sampling: p in the validation window: src/data/validation.json (until 4000 failures or 400k trials); elsewhere runPoint until 1500 failures or 300k trials. 95% Wilson intervals.

bitflip.source: Dennis et al. 2002; Wang, Harrington, Preskill 2003
bitflip.label: ours (validation.json)

circuit.label: literature
circuit.source: Fowler, Mariantoni, Martinis, Cleland, PRA 86, 032324 (2012): circuit-level threshold near 1%

lambda.note: Lambda = eps_d / eps_{d+2} from the runPoint sweep (bit-flip, MWPM)
